text:
Maya: thinking of a tight 40m webinar: three 8-min microdemos + 15-min customer story + 3m close. keeps energy high and gives more demo surface. ok?

Jon: yes. propose themes: 1) sub-50ms inference path, 2) cost-saving knobs (batching + quant), 3) fallback & routing. each demo = 6m demo + 2m audience q.

Priya: registration plan: short form (email, company, use-case) -> webhook -> HubSpot tag webinar_q3_2026. add hidden checkbox "send bench appendix" mapped to bench_interest.

Maya: we need two fallback clips per demo: 45s quick + 3m full. ClipBot please remind ops to upload to shared drive with naming conv.

ClipBot: (auto) Reminder set: upload webinar_2977770000_demo1_45s.mp4 etc. retry policy 3x.

Jon: rehearsal plan: record individual demos by Thu, full dress Fri 48h before. Alex to proctor live and trigger fallback at T-1:15 if demo health isn't green.

Priya: legal note: avoid calling out exact percent cost wins in promo. if we include numbers, submit bench docs to Legal for approval (48h SLA).

Maya: run-of-show draft: 00:00-02:00 intro, 02:00-10:00 demo 1, 10:00-18:00 demo 2, 18:00-26:00 demo 3, 26:00-41:00 customer story, 41:00-43:00 AMA, 43:00-45:00 CTA close.

Cara: marketing will triage live Qs; escalation rule: tag eng with "eng-answer" for technical follow-ups. I'll assemble speaker cue cards with fallback timestamps.

Priya: I'll wire the webhook and post the form link here when live. timeline: promos start Tue, recordings due Thu, full dress Fri.

Maya: thanks team 680. small ask: can we gate the bench appendix for registrants? seems like a good lead qualifier.

Jon: agreed. map bench_interest to HubSpot property and include in SDR handoff rules.
